observations.observation: A read-only orientation probe guessed artifacts/verification/container-source-gate-baseline-0031-chainguard-python.json, but no file exists at that path.
observations.containment: The missing read was not treated as evidence and did not change repository, container, registry, or external state.
observations.correction: Inventory artifacts/verification explicitly, use the retained BASELINE-0027 Chainguard source gate only as a structural precedent, and assess the BASELINE-0032 digest independently from current primary publisher metadata.

observations.observation: The first governed milestone validation rejected path_efficiency.consecutive_no_progress_threshold because the schema requires max_consecutive_no_progress_units.
observations.containment: The invalid milestone had not been committed, pushed, or used to authorize work; the validator returned no eligible next unit.
observations.correction: Use the exact governed key path_efficiency.max_consecutive_no_progress_units and rerun the independent milestone validator before publication.

observations.observation: The first combined documentation patch declared two separate update operations for docs/status.md, so apply_patch rejected the entire patch before applying any hunk.
observations.containment: No documentation or repository byte changed and the rejected patch was not used as evidence.
observations.correction: Apply one status-file operation containing both hunks, then apply each remaining living-record update once and validate the complete diff.

observations.observation: The first bounded scan searched complete contents of every modified tracked file and reported one historical docs/devlog.md line that quotes the literal private-key delimiter as an earlier forbidden-pattern false positive.
observations.containment: The result was treated as unresolved until located; it is historical explanatory text, not credential material, and no publication action followed the aggregate count.
observations.correction: Scan only added lines for modified tracked files and full contents for untracked files, retain the historical literal as known non-secret text, and require zero unresolved current-delta hits before commit.

observations.observation: The first read-only identity inventory placed a pipeline immediately after a foreach statement, and PowerShell rejected the empty pipeline before collecting measurements.
observations.containment: No repository, container, registry, or external state changed, and the rejected command produced no evidence used by the checkpoint.
observations.correction: Assign foreach output to an array before piping it to ConvertTo-Json, then recompute every file identity after implementation edits.

observations.observation: A read-only Git tree query passed HEAD^{tree} through PowerShell without a quoting-safe format, causing the shell to transform the brace expression and Git to reject the resulting revision.
observations.containment: The commit and status probes still completed, no repository or external state changed, and the rejected tree value was not used as evidence.
observations.correction: Use git show -s --format=%T HEAD for tree identity on PowerShell and retain the corrected exact tree separately.

observations.observation: The first successor contract validation found that the package and container versioned copies each contained one extra terminal blank line introduced while transporting otherwise identical active-contract text into apply_patch.
observations.containment: Both validators failed closed on byte inequality; neither mismatched copy was committed, published, or used to authorize a build.
observations.correction: Remove the single extra blank line with apply_patch and require byte equality between each active and versioned contract before continuing.

observations.observation: The first targeted unittest command addressed BaselineTests instead of the actual BaselineTest class, while the base-refresh unit test still required the preimplementation frozen phase after the authorized implementation was present.
observations.containment: The test loader errors and stale-phase assertion were retained as failures; no build, repository publication, or external action followed them.
observations.correction: Advance the unit test to the implemented phase, use the exact singular test class, and rerun the complete targeted set before the full suite.

observations.observation: The first changed-file identity command wrapped tracked and untracked Git path lists as two nested arrays, causing Get-Item and Get-FileHash to emit aggregated array-valued records instead of one record per path.
observations.containment: The malformed 29-path and 3-path aggregate was rejected and not used in a seal, commit, or publication decision.
observations.correction: Append each Git path list into one flat array, sort unique paths, and require one path, byte count, and SHA-256 per record.

observations.observation: The first exact secret-hit locator again piped directly from a foreach block, and PowerShell rejected the empty pipe before returning any locations.
observations.containment: No scan result was inferred from the parser failure and no repository, container, or external state changed.
observations.correction: Accumulate Select-String results in an explicit array, emit only after both loops finish, and force a successful read-only exit after exact localization.

observations.observation: The full-content scan of three untracked files found one private-key delimiter literal in eval/package-contract-0032.json, where the contract declares that delimiter as a forbidden archive-content pattern.
observations.containment: The exact line was inspected; it is a project-authored deny-list value, not key material. Added tracked lines had zero pattern hits and no unresolved secret-shaped value was accepted.
observations.correction: Retain the declared forbidden literal, classify the single hit as resolved non-secret contract text, and require zero unresolved added-line or untracked-file hits.

observations.observation: The first post-push reconciliation found the local origin/codex/baseline-0032-container-base-security-refresh tracking ref still at 028e46bb even though ls-remote and anonymous GitHub already returned implementation commit ead044ee.
observations.containment: The aggregate all-heads check remained false, so the observation was not promoted to a passing public seal despite exact anonymous commit, tree, blob, raw-byte, and public-main evidence.
observations.correction: Fetch the exact public branch into its explicit local tracking ref and repeat every ref, commit, tree, Git-blob, raw-byte, and public-main check before recording the passing receipt.

observations.observation: A wording-only version-history patch matched only the leading cells of a longer Markdown table row, so apply_patch could not find the incomplete expected line and rejected the edit.
observations.containment: No file changed and the rejected patch was not used as evidence.
observations.correction: Read the exact complete row and replace that full line once, changing evaluation active to the narrower evaluation unit ready claim.

observations.observation: The first explicit active-versus-archived manifest equality expression combined byte-array joins and comparison without grouping, producing a string-valued False even though both files had the same length and SHA-256.
observations.containment: The malformed equality output was not used to accept the manifest; both generated files remained unchanged and the manifest validator independently passed.
observations.correction: Compare Base64 encodings of the complete byte arrays with a case-sensitive equality operator, confirming both 18,484-byte files are exact at SHA-256 711b6016f2856cdd41c9eb7f9459320666e9b424e599bea52e1abad4e0fa7264.

observations.observation: The first full suite against the renewed BASELINE-0032 manifest passed 93 of 94 tests but failed retrieval-tier current_contract_phase because the production validator supplied mutable eval/manifest.json when authenticating the retained BASELINE-0031 lifecycle report.
observations.containment: No package, evaluation candidate, or derived image was built. The 95.746-second failed run, errors active_evaluation_lifecycle_identity and control_manifest_sha256, and unchanged selected retrieval configuration were retained.
observations.correction: Replace the mutable pointer with an immutable retained lifecycle manifest, add a regression test that forbids eval/manifest.json, and require exact report-to-manifest SHA-256 validation before refreezing BASELINE-0032 source identity; the first candidate archive is separately rejected in OBS-016.

observations.observation: The first bounded pointer correction selected the general BASELINE-0031 prebuild manifest at SHA-256 9cdb30aa, but current retained latest.json binds the later attempt-002 lifecycle manifest at SHA-256 e2ea1bca; the validator and current-phase test correctly remained failed.
observations.containment: The two-test correction check passed only the new immutability assertion and failed current phase; no manifest refreeze, package, evaluation candidate, or derived image followed the mismatch.
observations.correction: Bind the production lifecycle check to immutable baseline-0031-final-source-attempt-002.manifest.json, whose SHA-256 exactly equals retained latest.json manifest_sha256, while leaving the frozen retrieval selection evidence and all behavior unchanged.

observations.observation: A compact read-only PowerShell manifest-hash inventory exited 1 without producing usable output, so it could not localize the lifecycle mismatch.
observations.containment: No missing value was inferred, and the failed command changed no file or external state.
observations.correction: Use a read-only Python inventory to report retained latest.json checkpoint, bound manifest SHA-256, and all candidate manifest lengths and hashes before selecting the exact attempt-002 artifact.

observations.observation: The first combined prebuild documentation patch again supplied only the leading cells of the long v0.0.32 version-history row, so apply_patch rejected the entire multi-file patch before applying any hunk.
observations.containment: No living record changed and the rejected patch was not used as evidence.
observations.correction: Apply the non-table living-record changes in one atomic patch, read the exact complete version-history row, and replace that full row separately.

observations.observation: The first resumed reconciliation command passed unquoted HEAD^{tree} through PowerShell, which transformed the brace expression and caused git rev-parse to reject an encoded token instead of resolving the tree.
observations.containment: The parser failure was not used as tree evidence; the command changed no repository, package, container, registry, or external state.
observations.correction: Quote the complete HEAD^{tree} revision expression and require the resolved value to equal the known prebuild tree c89a8d94edfea27881dac3c77b7ffd06ceac62d6.

observations.observation: The same resumed command guessed scripts/verify_milestone.py, but this repository has no validator at that path.
observations.containment: The missing-file result was treated as process-invalid, not a milestone pass or failure, and no publication or build action followed it.
observations.correction: Invoke the installed run-controlled-milestone skill validator at C:/Users/drewb/.codex/skills/run-controlled-milestone/scripts/validate_milestone.py against the exact active contract before publication.
